content_html:
watched TubeLight……

Salman Khan the BHAI……can earn you hundreds of crores even with medicore routine subjects and depend solely on his Screen Presence like Dabang, Ready & Prem Ratan Dhan Payo!!!!

but that doesnt mean that Salman Khan the ACTOR….cannot earn you even a single crore with Scripts which are offbeat and depend solely on his ACTING capabilities like Tube Light!!!

Bhajarangi was a runaway hit with its strong storyline packed with various emotions and doesnt rely on Bhaijan’s acting talent…..and Salman’s screen presence has just elevated it to Blockbuster!!!

but TubeLight script itself has to rely on Lakshman’s emotions, Bonding and Childishness……thats exactly where Kabir Khan has failed completely in casting Salman. With Salman onboard (TUBE)light was thrown on scripts loopholes rather than putting them in Dark.

with due respect to Salman’s whole hearted efforts to fill the shoes of Lakshman aka TubeLight…….but we cannot imagine Salman trying to replicate Kamal Hasan’s performance at railway station in Sadma’s climax.

Bottom Line : Neither Fans accept Bhai being a Tubelight nor regular audience digest the fact that Tubelight is being played by Bhai!!!!
